study: Controlled personalization and real-semantic profiling extension v1
evaluation_status: Post-test exploratory; previous final results have been inspected.

prior_results.policy: All original measurements, source specifications and artifact receipts remain immutable.

personalization.history_inputs: Admitted training exposures only; whole-block upper bound <= target lower bound. No outcome-selected history or held-out appends.
personalization.fitting_selection: Label-independent per-user hash selection, capped before positive/history eligibility; report all attrition.
personalization.architecture: One attention-pooling and residual shared user head, below 2000000 trainable parameters.
personalization.loss: Multi-positive sampled-softmax against frozen item vectors.
personalization.loss_equation: For each fitting query, logsumexp(s_i/tau for i in P union L union U) minus logsumexp(s_i/tau for i in P); average equally over fitting queries. All P have unit weight.
personalization.negative_construction: Retain every covered fitting positive P. Sample up to12 distinct logged nonpositives L excluding P; sample up to64 distinct catalog alternatives U excluding P and L. Fixed once per seed/query. No validation/test labels are consulted.
personalization.wrong_user_control: Held-out inference input only, deterministic whole-user history derangement; no extra fitting labels.
personalization.order_control: Deterministic permutation of the same exposure multiset. The head includes learned relative-recency embeddings; mean/init invariance and trained temporal sensitivity are distinguished.
personalization.checkpoint_policy: Fixed epoch3, no validation-best or first-threshold selection. Pilot uses seed17 epoch3; seed23 epoch3 is trained only if the pilot admits expansion. Report seeds individually and mean of per-query metrics, not a prediction ensemble.
personalization.pilot_phase: Unchanged validation panel only, full-catalog exhaustive FP32 products over canonical stored items and FP16-rounded head queries, top1000.
personalization.final_evaluation: One frozen test evaluation of seed17 and controls even if pilot stops expansion; seed23 is added only after a passing validation pilot. No decisions use extension test metrics.
personalization.negative_truth: Logged nonpositive exposures and sampled unjudged catalog alternatives are distinct weak-negative sources; no propensity or exhaustive-negative claim.
personalization.primary_metric: Equal-user known-positive Recall@1000 on the unchanged conditional panel.

pilot_gate.hit_user_arm: Fixed seed17 epoch3 aligned learned head, not the best control or best epoch.
pilot_gate.interpretation: Proposed information-value gate, not power analysis or evidence of no signal if failed.

research_qualification_gate.interpretation: Scoped exploratory research qualification, not causal engagement uplift or production adoption proof.

canonical_query_parity.scope: Declared pre-execution tolerance on FP16-canonicalized raw and cached query vectors, not bit-exact equality. Exact candidate/final IDs and scorer tolerance remain separately required.
canonical_query_parity.report: Maximum absolute difference, minimum cosine and changed canonical values for initial100 probes and every measured/pretrace batch.

profiling.trace_policy: CPU/CUDA trace in separate executions; unprofiled synchronized wall time is the performance measure. Overlapping stage durations are not summed.
profiling.quality_population: Same fixed 1097-query IR cohort for both scorers; each point uses its own actual single-retriever candidates and timed prefix policy.
profiling.quality_reference: Corresponding actual FAISS FP32 candidate-producing point on the same panel and scorer.
profiling.latency_reference: Fresh corresponding FAISS FP32 resident pipeline with this extension timing protocol; earlier three-sample timing is not reused.
profiling.reference_memory_policy: Reference-only FP32 may be measured at admitted batch1/16 shapes with at least2GiB observed headroom. It is not qualified as a deployment candidate unless it also meets8GiB; no batch64 reference stress if unsafe.
primary_quality_contrasts: Silver rowwise INT8 minus FAISS FP32, probes64/top1000/cap50/semantic-MLP-seed17
profiling.primary_quality_population: MRR@10 on the fixed1000 selected dev-small queries only. TREC43/54 remain separate graded populations.
profiling.uncertainty: Paired query bootstrap,20000 draws,seed20261011. Two primary contrasts use Bonferroni-adjusted97.5% two-sided percentile intervals; all other pointwise95% intervals are exploratory secondary comparisons, not a globally selected winner.
profiling.boundary_control: Paired resident/local-cascade cached MLP within each backend; exact candidate/final IDs and score tolerance rtol=1e-5,atol=1e-5.
profiling.paired_schedule: Shared label-independent hash-selected query batches across backends/caps/paths within session and batch shape; counterbalanced backend and boundary order across restarted sessions.
profiling.required_lower_confidence_bound: Candidate minus reference MRR lower bound > -0.002; otherwise failed or inconclusive, not equivalence.
profiling.alternative_benefit: Quantified memory savings with comparable quality/latency.
profiling.comparable_latency_tolerance: At most5% slower mean complete-pipeline wall time versus the fresh corresponding reference; all three sessions reported.
profiling.headroom_interpretation: Finite sampled/stress admission criterion, not protection against all unseen peaks.

stretch.task: One fixed query-only Qwen0.6 LoRA pilot against the frozen full IR item bank.

review_policy.numeric_context_limit: Not exposed by the tool; no unverified 1M-token capacity claim.
